name: 98367 · Port Orchard, WA
findings: ZIP 98367 (Port Orchard) has 73 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 25 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98367 (Port Orchard) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98367 (Port Orchard) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
